## The textbook, part by part {#textbook}

The course follows *Vibes to Variables* (3rd Edition) in five parts. Each part has a page on this site with its goals and assignments, and its chapters are in the free online textbook.

### Part I: Foundation

- [Phase I: The Journalist](../modules/01_journalist/index.qmd)
- [Chapter 1: The Science of Storytelling](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter01.html)
- [Chapter 2: The Open Workspace](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter02.html)
- [Chapter 3: Knowing and Knowing Well](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter03.html)

### Part II: Planning

- [Phase II: The Architect](../modules/02_architect/index.qmd)
- [Chapter 4: Intelligence Gathering](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter04.html)
- [Chapter 5: Theory as a Lens](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter05.html)
- [Chapter 6: The Prospectus](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter06.html)

### Part III: Operationalization

- [Phase III: The Builder](../modules/03_builder/index.qmd)
- [Chapter 7: Structured Listening](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter07.html)
- [Chapter 8: From Vibes to Variables](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter08.html)
- [Chapter 9: The Rulebook and First Workspace](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter09.html)

### Part IV: Execution

- [Phase IV: The Analyst](../modules/04_analyst/index.qmd)
- [Chapter 10: The Sample](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter10.html)
- [Chapter 11: Wrangling the Data](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter11.html)
- [Chapter 12: Visualizing the Narrative](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter12.html)
- [Practice: Pokemon Wrangling](../modules/04_analyst/practice-wrangling.qmd)

### Part V: Inference and Publication

- [Phase V: The Publisher](../modules/05_publisher/index.qmd)
- [Chapter 13: Making the Call](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter13.html)
- [Chapter 14: The One-Click Report](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/chapters/chapter14.html)
